cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# Firmware version reported in esp_app_desc and the boot log.  Keep it in
# firmware/VERSION so a clean clone builds a reproducible version string
# instead of "unknown" (git describe is not available in a source archive).
file(STRINGS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/VERSION" PROJECT_VER LIMIT_COUNT 1)

# OpenRadioLink-v0.3  --  ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8
#
# The board takes its identity from the measured schematic; the pin map used by
# the code lives in main/board_pins.h and is generated by tools/gen_pinmap.py.
# Re-run that generator after any schematic change.
#
# The target is fixed with `idf.py set-target esp32s3` (see tools/idf.ps1), so
# SUPPORTED_TARGETS is deliberately not restricted here.

include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)

project(openradiolink)

# libopus (via the micro-opus component) trips -Werror=maybe-uninitialized under
# GCC 14 on silk/NLSF2A.c: a table that is in fact always initialised before use.
# Keep the warning visible, just do not let it fail the build.
add_compile_options(-Wno-error=maybe-uninitialized)
# ...and append it to the global option list too: IDF adds -Werror=all per
# component AFTER the target-level options above, which re-enables the error.
idf_build_set_property(COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-error=maybe-uninitialized" APPEND)
